{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.56

|gr1= GUI Control - Menu

|gr2= Broken Commands

|descr= Returns a string containing shortcut text for menu item on the given path.

|pr= {{Feature|warning|This command is currently broken in {{arma3}} 2.00. It only returns shortcuts which do not use a modifier key ({{Controls|Ctrl}}, {{Controls|Alt}} and {{Controls|Shift}}).}}

|s1= [[menuShortcutText]] [idc, path]

|p1= idc: [[Number]]

|p2= path: [[Tree View Path]]

|r1= [[String]]

|s2= control [[menuShortcutText]] path

|p21= control: [[Control]]

|p22= path: [[Tree View Path]]

|r2= [[String]]

|x1= <sqf>findDisplay 313 displayCtrl 120 menuShortcutText [1, 8]; // returns "#"</sqf>

|seealso= [[menuShortcut]] [[menuSetShortcut]]
}}
